 Barcelona Under PRESSURE! FC Barcelona vs. Alaves La Liga MATCH PREVIEW! - Scoreline
 Barcelona entered the season with a PERFECT start, looking like one of the most dangerous teams in Europe! However, back-to-back losses against PSG in the Champions League and bitter rivals Real Madrid in El Clásico have raised serious questions about Hansi Flick's side. With pressure beginning to mount, Barcelona now turn their attention to Alavés as they look to get their season back on track. Can Lamine Yamal and company BOUNCE BACK with a statement victory, or will Barcelona's struggles continue?
